ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels distributed across the central lobes; 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the trailing edges, lateral tips, and in radiating striations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes contain large, contiguous white blobs. High-contrast black mottling forms a dense border along the trailing edge. Thin, linear black streaks radiate from the notch area toward the outer margins. The lateral tips are predominantly solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with an estimated aperture of 110-120 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular topography with high-frequency variations. The contour consists of recurring bulbous peaks (calcified barnacle clusters) and jagged valleys along the entire continuous linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep; the trailing edge follows a convex curve from the notch that flattens into a linear trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of circular, high-contrast white and tan clusters along the trailing edge and lateral tips, indicating significant barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions across both lobes; most prominent are the vertical and diagonal streaks on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle encrustation; visible parallel rake marks on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown pixel cluster (diatom film) located on the medial-lower section of the right lobe near the notch.
